body: The Esprima issue has been moved to jquery/esprima#1029.

issue.title: Expand property method range and loc to include params

repository.name: esprima
repository.description: ECMAScript parsing infrastructure for multipurpose analysis

issue.body:
Previously, the range and loc for get, set, and shorthand methods inside object literal properties included only the method body, meaning a method's parameters were outside the range of their parent `FunctionExpression` node. This was happening because the `FunctionExpression` node wasn't being created until `parsePropertyFunction` was called, by which point the method's parameters had already been parsed. This PR solves the issue by creating the `FunctionExpression` node as soon as it determines that the property is a get, set, or shorthand method, then passing the node into `parsePropertyFunction`.

If this gets merged, I'll port the same change to Espree as the fix for eslint/espree#36, which will enable a solution for eslint/eslint#1680.

I attempted to follow the contribution guidelines, but please let me know if I missed anything.

Closes #1029
Closes #1040
